scene: Hanoi, Vietnam: Hoan Kiem Lake with the small three-tier Turtle Tower on its tiny island, the red arched The Huc wooden bridge leading to Ngoc Son temple, willow trees on the lake shore, Old Quarter narrow tube houses with yellow facades and red tiled roofs, the Long Bien steel bridge and a few modern towers in the distance.

Ha Long Bay, Vietnam: emerald green calm sea dotted with hundreds of towering limestone karst islands covered in green jungle, traditional wooden junk boats with brown ribbed sails, a floating fishing village, misty karst layers fading into the distance.

Trang An, Ninh Binh, Vietnam: steep limestone karst mountains rising from a winding river, small bamboo sampan rowing boats, green rice paddy fields, an ancient stone gate and a multi-tiered pagoda on a hill, lush vegetation.

Sa Pa, Vietnam: layered green and golden terraced rice fields carved into steep mountain slopes, Fansipan peak among clouds, wooden stilt houses of a Hmong village, pine trees, low mist in the valley.
Ha Giang, Vietnam: the Ma Pi Leng pass road winding along a cliff, deep canyon of the emerald Nho Que river, jagged grey limestone mountains, pink buckwheat flower fields, small earthen houses.

Hue, Vietnam: the Imperial City Ngo Mon gate with yellow and red roofs and the tall flag tower, the Perfume River with dragon boats, the seven-story octagonal Thien Mu pagoda on the riverbank, green hills beyond.

Da Nang, Vietnam: the golden Dragon Bridge shaped like a curving dragon over the Han River, the Han River swing bridge, modern skyline of hotels and towers, Son Tra mountain with the white Lady Buddha statue, beach in the distance.

Hoi An ancient town, Vietnam: two-story yellow-walled old houses with dark tiled roofs and wooden shutters, hundreds of colorful silk lanterns strung across streets, the pink Japanese Covered Bridge, Thu Bon river with small wooden boats and floating paper lanterns.
Da Lat, Vietnam: Xuan Huong lake surrounded by tall pine forests, French colonial villas with pastel walls, the pink Domaine de Marie church, rolling misty hills, flower gardens and greenhouses.

Nha Trang, Vietnam: long curved sandy beach with coconut palms, turquoise bay with green islands, the ancient red-brick Po Nagar Cham towers on a hill, a row of high-rise beach hotels, a cable car line across the sea.

Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: the very tall Landmark 81 skyscraper, the Bitexco Financial Tower with its round helipad, the Saigon River with boats, the red-brick Notre-Dame Cathedral with twin spires, dense modern skyline.

Can Tho, Vietnam: the Cai Rang floating market with wooden boats loaded with fruit and vegetables, the wide brown Mekong river, the long cable-stayed Can Tho bridge in the distance, coconut palms and stilt houses on the riverbank.
Phu Quoc island, Vietnam: white sand beach, crystal turquoise sea, leaning coconut palm trees, colorful fishing boats, a long sea cable car to small islands, a lighthouse on a rocky headland.
Tokyo, Japan: Tokyo Skytree tower on the left, dense skyline of skyscrapers, Mount Fuji with a snowy peak in the distance, the Sumida river, pink cherry blossom trees along the riverbank.
Kyoto, Japan: the five-story Yasaka pagoda above traditional wooden machiya houses with dark tiled roofs, red maple autumn trees, a big red torii gate, forested mountains of Higashiyama behind.
Osaka, Japan: Osaka Castle with white walls and green-tiled golden-trimmed roofs on massive stone walls and a moat, cherry blossoms, the modern Umeda skyline and Abeno Harukas tower behind.

Seoul, South Korea: N Seoul Tower on forested Namsan mountain, the curved tiled roofs of Gyeongbokgung palace, the tall Lotte World Tower, the Han River with bridges, rugged mountains around the city, autumn trees.

Shanghai, China: the Pudong skyline across the Huangpu river: the Oriental Pearl Tower with pink spheres, the twisting Shanghai Tower, the Shanghai World Financial Center with its bottle-opener top, Jin Mao tower, river cruise boats.
Beijing, China: the Great Wall winding along green mountain ridges with stone watchtowers, and in the lower foreground the golden-roofed halls and red walls of the Forbidden City, autumn trees.

Singapore: Marina Bay Sands three towers with the ship-shaped sky park on top, the Supertree Grove of Gardens by the Bay, the Merlion fountain, the Singapore Flyer ferris wheel, the bay with the skyline of the financial district.
Bangkok, Thailand: Wat Arun temple with its tall decorated prang spires on the Chao Phraya river bank, longtail boats, golden Grand Palace roofs, modern skyscrapers behind, palm trees.
Angkor Wat, Cambodia: the temple's five lotus-bud stone towers reflected in the front pond, long stone causeway, tall sugar palm trees, dense jungle around.

Kathmandu, Nepal: the white dome of Boudhanath stupa with painted Buddha eyes and colorful prayer flags, brick houses and pagoda temples of Durbar Square, snowy Himalaya peaks towering in the distance.

Dubai, UAE: the ultra-tall Burj Khalifa, the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab hotel on its island, a glittering modern skyline, the turquoise Persian Gulf, golden desert dunes at the edge of the city, a mosque with a dome and minarets.
Giza, Egypt: the three Great Pyramids and the Great Sphinx on the golden desert plateau, a camel caravan, date palm trees along the Nile in the foreground, Cairo city faint in the distance.
Istanbul, Turkey: the domes and slender minarets of the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia on the skyline, the Bosphorus strait with ferries and seagulls, the Galata Tower, the Bosphorus suspension bridge.
Athens, Greece: the Parthenon on top of the rocky Acropolis hill, white houses spreading below, olive trees and cypress, Mount Lycabettus with a small white chapel.
Rome, Italy: the Colosseum, the dome of St. Peter's Basilica, terracotta rooftops and bell towers, the Tiber river with a stone arched bridge, umbrella pine trees.

Paris, France: the Eiffel Tower, the Seine river with stone bridges and tour boats, cream Haussmann buildings with grey mansard roofs, Sacre-Coeur basilica white domes on Montmartre hill, chestnut trees.
London, UK: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower) and the Houses of Parliament on the Thames, the London Eye ferris wheel, Tower Bridge in the distance, the Shard, a red double-decker bus on Westminster Bridge.

Amsterdam, Netherlands: narrow tall gabled canal houses in brown, red and white, a canal with small boats and houseboats, bicycles on an arched brick bridge, a traditional windmill and tulip fields at the edge.
Prague, Czech Republic: Charles Bridge with its baroque statues over the Vltava river, Prague Castle and the gothic St. Vitus Cathedral on the hill, sea of red rooftops and church spires.
Stockholm, Sweden: the colorful ochre and red buildings of Gamla Stan on the waterfront, the Stockholm City Hall brick tower with three golden crowns, archipelago boats, pine-covered islands.
Moscow, Russia: Saint Basil's Cathedral with colorful swirled onion domes on Red Square, the red brick Kremlin walls and towers with red stars, the Moskva river, snow on the rooftops.
New York City, USA: the Manhattan skyline with the Empire State Building and One World Trade Center, the Brooklyn Bridge stone towers and cables, the Statue of Liberty in the harbor, autumn trees.
San Francisco, USA: the red Golden Gate Bridge over the bay with rolling fog, colorful Victorian 'Painted Ladies' houses on a hill, the Transamerica Pyramid, sailboats, Alcatraz island.
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: the Christ the Redeemer statue on top of Corcovado mountain, Sugarloaf mountain with its cable car, Copacabana beach curve, lush green granite hills.
Sydney, Australia: the Sydney Opera House with its white shell sails, the Sydney Harbour Bridge steel arch, harbour ferries, the city skyline and Sydney Tower.
Arctic Iceland: bright green and violet aurora borealis curtains dancing over snowy mountains and a frozen lake, a few red wooden cabins with warm lit windows, snowy pine trees.
